luau.trace.server.reason: VS Code client tracing is editor-owned; use the editor's standard LSP trace support.

luau-lsp.server.path.reason: The distribution owns and pins its private upstream executable; use --upstream only for wrapper development.

luau-lsp.server.communicationChannel.reason: Managed Roblox sessions require stdio so the wrapper can proxy standard LSP; standard sessions pass upstream pipe arguments through.

luau-lsp.server.crashReporting.enabled.reason: Translated to upstream crash-reporting arguments when the bundled build supports them.

luau-lsp.platform.type.reason: Selects managed Roblox mode or transparent standard mode before server startup.

luau-lsp.sourcemap.enabled.reason: Controls wrapper-owned sourcemap monitoring and is also forwarded to the server.

luau-lsp.sourcemap.rojoPath.reason: Selects the Rojo executable launched by the wrapper.

luau-lsp.sourcemap.rojoProjectFile.reason: Selects the Rojo project used by the wrapper.

luau-lsp.sourcemap.sourcemapFile.reason: Selects the generated file monitored by the wrapper and read by the server.

luau-lsp.sourcemap.generatorCommand.reason: Parsed without a shell and launched as a session-owned process.

luau-lsp.sourcemap.useVSCodeWatcher.reason: Reproduced with an editor-neutral workspace file poller.

luau-lsp.format.convertQuotes.reason: The server's standard on-type edit is forwarded, but a private editor cursor command cannot be reproduced portably.

luau-lsp.fflags.enableByDefault.reason: Translated to upstream flag startup behavior.

luau-lsp.fflags.enableNewSolver.reason: Enables LuauSolverV2 only when the bundled server advertises that flag.

luau-lsp.fflags.sync.reason: The wrapper intersects live Roblox values with the bundled server's --show-flags registry.

luau-lsp.fflags.override.reason: Validated against the bundled registry and applied after synchronized values.

luau-lsp.diagnostics.pullOnChange.reason: Diagnostic pull scheduling belongs to the LSP client; configure it in the editor.

luau-lsp.diagnostics.pullOnSave.reason: Diagnostic pull scheduling belongs to the LSP client; configure it in the editor.

luau-lsp.types.definitionFiles.reason: Paths and URLs are resolved before startup and supplied through upstream definition arguments.

luau-lsp.types.documentationFiles.reason: Paths and URLs are resolved before startup and supplied through upstream documentation arguments.

luau-lsp.types.roblox.reason: Deprecated alias retained for automatic Roblox definitions.

luau-lsp.types.robloxSecurityLevel.reason: Selects the downloaded Roblox definition set before startup.

luau-lsp.inlayHints.makeInsertable.reason: Implemented through standard LSP inlay hint edits when the client supports them.

luau-lsp.autocompleteEnd.reason: Deprecated editor command; portable completion edits work only when exposed by the client's standard LSP behavior.

luau-lsp.completion.autocompleteEnd.reason: Portable completion edits work only when exposed by the client's standard LSP behavior; private editor commands are unavailable.

luau-lsp.completion.showAnonymousAutofil.reason: Deprecated alias implemented by the language server.

luau-lsp.completion.suggestImports.reason: Deprecated alias implemented by the language server.

luau-lsp.completion.imports.stringRequir.reason: Implemented by the language server's Roblox platform.

luau-lsp.studioPlugin.enabled.reason: Controls the wrapper-owned loopback Studio bridge.

luau-lsp.studioPlugin.port.reason: Selects the loopback Studio bridge port.

luau-lsp.studioPlugin.maximumRequestBody.reason: Limits Studio request bodies before JSON parsing.

luau-lsp.require.fileAliases.reason: Deprecated setting implemented by the language server.

luau-lsp.require.directoryAliases.reason: Deprecated setting implemented by the language server.

luau-lsp.require.useOriginalRequireByStr.reason: Deprecated setting implemented by the language server.

luau-lsp.bytecode.debugLevel.reason: Implemented by upstream compiler inspection requests.

luau-lsp.bytecode.typeInfoLevel.reason: Implemented by upstream compiler inspection requests.

luau-lsp.bytecode.vectorLib.reason: Implemented by upstream compiler inspection requests.

luau-lsp.bytecode.vectorCtor.reason: Implemented by upstream compiler inspection requests.

luau-lsp.bytecode.vectorType.reason: Implemented by upstream compiler inspection requests.
